description: This Java class handles the 'close client' command in the Fineract project, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegating the closing operation to the ClientWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CloseClientCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the command to close a client in the Fineract system. It uses dependency injection to obtain the client write service and processes the command within a transaction.

methods.name: CloseClientCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the close client command by delegating to the ClientWritePlatformService's closeClient method.
